content_of_post_to_comment: I am 13 and my name is Leo I have struggled with gooning for about 3-4ish months and for the first 10 times I gooned I thought I though I was so cool and so mature about it but really I didn't know what type of rabbit hole I was going down and I have tried many times with my record only being 18 days which is really sad and I want to quit before no nut November and I really would like if someone commented on this with help because I believe that if someone gave me some motivation and tips that it could help stop me for gooning or gooning in general. I also would like a reason to start working out I am very athletic (No Glaze) but I think I could start putting on some more msucle before my volleyball season really starts up I have heard that Calisthenics are good for playing sports where I am not body builder strong but also not pipe cleaner sticks for legs. So if anyone could help with tips or tricks or even just give me some motivation this is the first place where I have truly opened up.
comment: Being 13 and already noticing that something is taking more control than you want is actually a good sign. Don’t make the goal just “never do it again” because that can turn into a cycle of guilt. Filling the time with volleyball training, calisthenics, and other goals can make a bigger difference because you’re building a life you enjoy. Also, don’t beat yourself up over the 18-day record; that’s proof you can change habits.
